recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR-core change is needed for FHIR-12147 unless a future work group reopens canonical-resource metadata design.
issue_request: FHIR-12147 asked to harmonize conformance resource metadata by adding a computable-name warning invariant; renaming display to title, requirements to purpose, context to usageContext, code to keyword, and RelatedResource to RelatedArtifact; using PublicationStatus; and adding date, approvalDate/effectivePeriod, jurisdiction, and related metadata across conformance/knowledge resources. The Jira state is Published with Persuasive resolution.
initial_application: Jira comments record application in SVN revisions 9970-9975 for the name invariant, StructureDefinition/title/status/purpose/keyword/RelatedArtifact work, date metadata, and context/jurisdiction changes. No current Git commit explicitly tagged FHIR-12147 was found, but the source state reflects the requested harmonization.
additional_context: Current FHIR uses shared CanonicalResource and MetadataResource interfaces rather than the exact DSTU2-era conformance-resource pattern. DataElement is commented out of the current resource list, Conformance has been superseded by CapabilityStatement, and the current model uses useContext of type UsageContext rather than reverting to an obsolete context/usageContext spelling.
reconciliation: No source change was made. CanonicalResource and MetadataResource already define the harmonized current metadata, old type/name artifacts are absent, and active build-scope resources inherit or define the relevant metadata elements.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive DSTU2 request to harmonize conformance resource metadata, with Jira comments recording staged application in SVN revisions 9970-9975.
